subject.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure

question: After the requester completion turn has run without acceptable required message-tool evidence, should OpenClaw permanently terminalize visible delivery as this head does, or require an isolated delivery-only retry mechanism?
rationale: The choice changes established fallback, cleanup, persistence, and message-delivery behavior for existing subagent workflows; code correctness alone cannot establish the intended product contract.

options.title: Approve terminal failure
options.body: Accept the current replay-safe contract, require exact-head runtime and restart proof, and surface the failed visible-delivery state diagnostically.

options.title: Require isolated visible retry
options.body: Keep the PR open for a delivery-only operation that can retry output without re-running requester orchestration or other side effects.

options.title: Preserve current behavior
options.body: Pause or close this contract change if neither terminal message loss nor a new delivery-only primitive is currently acceptable.

recommendation.title: Approve terminal failure
recommendation.body: Accept the current replay-safe contract, require exact-head runtime and restart proof, and surface the failed visible-delivery state diagnostically.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history most strongly connects this person to the lifecycle, persistence, and announce-delivery boundary requiring the contract decision.
